name: Azul Mousseigne
role: Level Designer · Diseño de Niveles — 日本語テスト
heroText: I design levels that make playing feel inevitable. Pacing, space, and difficulty curve — from paper sketch to final playtest.
aboutText: Level Designer focused on 3D platforming and combat design. I work from greybox to final polish, pairing design documentation with fast in-engine iteration. Before games, I studied narrative — it shows in how I think about the pacing of every space.
